turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Good morning, Mr./Ms./Mrs. [Name]. I'm [Provider's Name], the anesthesiologist who will be taking care of you during your surgery today. I'd like to go through some questions to ensure we have all the necessary information for your safety. Is that okay with you?

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Thank you. Can you please tell me a bit about your medical history, especially related to your current condition that requires a laparoscopic cholecystectomy?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Okay lah... I've been having stomach pains, especially after eating. The doctor said it's because of my gallbladder, so they decided to remove it. I think that's all, really.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: I see. Thank you for sharing that. Now, let's move on to your medications. I have in my records that you're on Metformin, Lisinopril, Atorvastatin, and Ranitidine. Can you confirm if you are still taking all of these medications as listed?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Ah, about the Ranitidine, doctor... I actually stopped taking it about six months ago because it was causing me some side effects. I'm not on any H2 blocker now.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Thank you for clarifying that. It's important we have the most up-to-date information. Are you currently taking any other medications, supplements, or herbal remedies not listed here?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: No, doctor. Just the Metformin, Lisinopril, and Atorvastatin. That's all.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Great. Now, regarding allergies, we have penicillin listed with a rash reaction. Are there any other allergies or reactions to medications or foods we should be aware of?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: No, just the penicillin. That's the only one.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Excellent. Have you had any previous surgeries or anesthesia? If so, were there any complications?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: No, this is my first time. I've never had surgery before.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Alright. Now, in terms of your current health, how would you rate your overall energy level and ability to perform daily activities? For example, can you climb stairs or walk for a certain distance without getting too tired?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Hmm, I can walk around, but sometimes I get a bit tired faster than before, especially with the diabetes and all. But I manage lah.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Thank you for sharing that. It helps us understand your functional status. Finally, have you eaten or drunk anything since midnight? It's important for your safety with the anesthesia.

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: No, doctor. I've been fasting since last night as instructed.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Perfect. Well, I think that covers everything. Thank you so much for your time and for providing all this information. It's crucial for us to provide the best care possible. If you have any questions or concerns, please don't hesitate to ask.

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Thank you, doctor. I feel more at ease now.
